description: GREATEST and LEAST widen across every argument's type instead of taking only the first argument's type

columns.name: g
columns.note: price (int32) vs msrp (decimal) widens to decimal; both operands are NOT NULL so the result is non-null

name: greatest_least_widen
query_sql:
-- @name GetPriceBounds
-- @returns :many
SELECT GREATEST(price, msrp) AS g, LEAST(price, msrp) AS l FROM order_items
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE order_items (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, price INTEGER NOT NULL, msrp NUMERIC NOT NULL)
